ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
liquipydia is a Python client for the Liquipedia API (LPDB v3), covering
all 16 data types. It is the spiritual successor to the abandoned
liquipediapy, targeting the modern REST API instead of the old MediaWiki
one. Features include a typed httpx2-based client with rate limiting and
pagination, Pydantic v2 response models, a resource-per-endpoint
architecture, and keyword filters that auto-convert to LPDB conditions.
about.summary: Python client library for the Liquipedia API (LPDB v3).

name: liquipydia
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "liquipydia" %}
{% set version = "0.2.0" %}
{% set python_min = "3.12" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 7677d8e6ba936a32336f634bc140baac0989e1f5bb447f902b9f340b71d28ca1

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - hatchling
    - pip
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - httpx2 >=2.16,<3
    - pydantic >=2.13,<3

test:
  imports:
    - liquipydia
  commands:
    - pip check
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip

about:
  home: https://github.com/Dyl-M/liquipydia
  summary: Python client library for the Liquipedia API (LPDB v3).
  description: |
    liquipydia is a Python client for the Liquipedia API (LPDB v3), covering
    all 16 data types. It is the spiritual successor to the abandoned
    liquipediapy, targeting the modern REST API instead of the old MediaWiki
    one. Features include a typed httpx2-based client with rate limiting and
    pagination, Pydantic v2 response models, a resource-per-endpoint
    architecture, and keyword filters that auto-convert to LPDB conditions.
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  doc_url: https://dyl-m.github.io/liquipydia/
  dev_url: https://github.com/Dyl-M/liquipydia

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - Dyl-M
